cutup.title: Make a Dadaist profile
cutup.hint: Cut the profile into words, shake the bag, and read whatever falls out.
cutup.credit: After Tristan Tzara’s recipe for a Dadaist poem, 1920.

hausmann.title: The Spirit of Our Time, 1920
hausmann.note: A head with no thoughts of its own, only the instruments fixed to it: a pocket watch, a tape measure, spectacles, a cup and a grade card reading 3.8.

duchamp.title: Bicycle Wheel, 1913
duchamp.note: The first readymade: a wheel and its fork set upside down in a kitchen stool. Drag across it to spin it.

manray.title: Gift, 1921
manray.note: A flat-iron with fourteen tacks on its sole: a useful object made useless, like a link to a page that is not here.
